title_en: 🌿 2+1 in MONARC Residence | Near May 5 & New Ring Road
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Monarc Residence, a new residential complex with contemporary architecture and quality construction standards, located in Paskuqan, in front of the "5 Maji" area and very close to the New Ring Road. An ideal opportunity for family residence or investment in a rapidly developing urban area. Apartment details: Gross area: 96.23 m² Net area: 83 m² Floor 5 New construction Construction phase Building with elevator Organization: Living room Kitchen room 2 bedrooms Toilets Balcony The residence offers modern spaces, natural lighting and functional layout. Only 5 minutes from the center of Tirana, with quick access to infrastructure, public transport and all necessary services.
